The Castle Hotel, Dublin
In the heart of Dublin, we are delighted to welcome you to our 121-bedroom 4 star hotel...
The Castle Hotel is set within nine elegantly restored Georgian townhouses. Relax in our comfortable, modern bedrooms, enjoy great food in a choice of two restaurants. Dine al fresco on our outdoor garden terrace and sit back and unwind in our wine cellar bar listening to live Irish music.
Car-parking available | Located just 2 minutes from O'Connell Street | The Aircoach, Dublin Airport Bus stops just 3 minutes' walk away | Walking Distance to many of Dublin's finest attractions. FIND OUT MORE

ROOMS AT THE CASTLE HOTEL
Rooms at the Castle Hotel are all en-suite and are elegantly decorated in warm tones with comfortable beds, crisp cotton sheets, and warm duvets.
When you stay with us you can choose from a range of comfortable individually designed bedrooms. We offer a choice of, Single , Double, Twin, Triple, Quad and Family Rooms to suit every traveller. Rooms are serviced daily and a hearty Breakfast is included in all of our rates.
Facilities include: Complimentary Breakfast, Tea and Coffee Tray - Direct Dial Telephone - Remote Control TV - Hairdryer and Complimentary WiFi access. Ba throoms have fluffy white towels and complimentary toiletries to make you feel pampered for the duration of your stay.

LOCATION OF THE CASTLE HOTEL
The Castle Hotel is located just off Parnell Square in the centre of Dublin, a short walking distance from all the major cultural and sporting venues.
Within easy walking distance are O'CONNELL ST, CROKE PARK, TEMPLE BAR, The ABBEY and GATE THEATRE, The HUGH LANE ART GALLERY, JAMES JOYCE CULTURAL CENTRE, Dublin's newest CINEMA COMPLEX and other major tourist attractions.
Being a short distance from the Financial Services Centre and Dublin's Convention Centre makes the hotel an ideal location for tourists and business travellers alike. The hotel has its own private car park and is convenient to airport, rail, and sea terminals.
We are within walking distance of four major hospitals in Dublin's city centre, CHI at Temple Street Children's Hospital, Mater Private, Mater Hospital and Rotunda Maternity Hospital.
For directions, please see our Directions page.

Home / Rooms / Family Friendly
Family Friendly Holidays in Dublin City Centre
Famous for our warm and welcoming atmosphere, The Castle Hotel is a popular choice for families visiting Dublin. We offer a variety of spacious family rooms, and plenty of dining options in either of our two family friendly restaurants and bars.
We are located in the heart of Dublin City Centre close to all public transport links giving easy access to Dublin's coastline, we also have car parking so should you choose to take the car you can be sitting on the nearest beach at Sandymount, in just 15 minutes. Hop on and Hop off bus routes are available on the doorstep.
We offer the perfect base to explore the many family attractions in the area including Dublin Zoo in the Phoenix park which is just 10 minutes' drive away or immerse yourself in history at any of the 3 National Museums of Dublin which are all less than 30 minutes' walk away and are all free to enter.
For Nature lovers the National Botanic Gardens with over 15000 plant species is also within walking distance to the hotel, here you will find a calm and beautiful green space. Open all year round and offering family friendly tours for the little ones to enjoy, they also have a regular calendar of events especially tailored for children.
These are just a very small selection of some of the many attractions suitable for the young and old which can be easily accessed from the Castle Hotel, you can find more details on other options below.
Our Family Friendly Bedrooms
We have a variety of spacious family bedrooms to suit all family types with plenty of space for the little ones to enjoy so you can make the most of your family time together and create those special memories. Our family rooms are suitable for 2 adults and up to 3 children, we are happy to offer discounts on multi-room bookings if teenagers or grandparents are joining you on your trip. Rooms are all en-suite, are serviced daily and a hearty Breakfast is included in all of our rates.

Family Friendly Fun Filled Activities
Dublin is the perfect location to create those precious memories with your family with a vast number of family friendly activities in the locality or within easy driving distance. Explore the city and its environs and all it has to offer whilst we look after all your needs leaving you free to enjoy your holiday and reconnect with family.
